$description: Wave 3 (W3 Forms-Core, D-015) component tokens for Radio. Same accent-scarcity reasoning as checkbox.json — selected dot uses `color.role.neutral.solid`, not `color.action.primary` (a radio group also renders multiple items per view; only one is selected at a time, but the group itself still isn't 'the single most important interactive element', and reusing the same non-scarce role token as Checkbox/Switch keeps all three selection controls visually consistent). Contrast numbers are identical to checkbox.json's checked state (same token pair): dot-vs-surface.raised 8.20:1 (light) / 7.94:1 (dark); ring border reuses `color.border.interactive` at 3.96:1 (light) / 3.54:1 (dark) against `surface.raised`.
